title: Velocity-Only Exclusion of Backward Self-Similar Navier-Stokes Profiles in a Half-Space
field: partial differential equations and fluid mechanics
decided_scope: Complete exclusion of non-trivial smooth no-slip backward self-similar Leray profiles in R^3_+ under velocity decay |U(y)| <= C/(1+|y|) and Lamb-vector alignment, without a priori derivative decay or pressure hypotheses
open_boundaries: Unrestricted half-space backward self-similar profiles without the Lamb-vector alignment inequality
